install.packages("RPostgres")
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)

# Establish connection
con <- dbConnect(
  RPostgres::Postgres(),
  host     = "localhost",
  port     = 5432,
  dbname   = "pgp_chat",
  user     = "postgres",
  password = "arthur"
)

# Query data
df <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM users")
df

dt <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT id,username, email FROM users" )
dt
# Close connection when done
dbDisconnect(con)

# Install the haven package
# haven is used to import statistical files
# such as SPSS, STATA, and SAS

install.packages("haven")


# Install readxl package
# readxl imports Excel files (.xlsx)

install.packages("readxl")

#Load Libraries into memory
library(haven)
# Load readxl package
library(readxl)

getwd()

# Create sample data log class1

data_class1 <- data.frame(
  student_id = c("MBI001", "MBI002", "MBI003", "MBI006", "MBI004", "MBI005", "MBI008", "MBI0010", "MBI0015"),
  department = c("Accounting", "Finance", "HR", "IT", "Finance", NA, "IT", "HR", "Accounting"),
  status = c("PASS", "FAIL", "PASS", "FAIL", "PASS", "PASS", "FAIL", "SUCCESS", "FAIL"),
  login_time = c("07:30", "08:00", "08:10", "08:15", "09:00", "09:20", "09:30", "10:00", "11:00")
  )

#adding ip variable
data_class1$ip_address <- c(
  "192.168.1.10",
  "10.0.0.5",
  "172.16.0.8",
  "192.168.1.10",
  "10.0.0.9",
  "10.0.0.5",
  "172.16.0.3",

  "192.168.1.10"
)

#Save as SPSS file (.sav)
write_sav(data_class1, "data_logs.sav")

read_sav("data_logs.sav")
list.files()

data_class1[is.na(data_class1$department), ]
